body: An added line, cited with an abbreviated path and a wrong line number.
A removed line: found in the old version.
An unchanged line far from the change: anchored, not in the diff.
A file that does not exist: unanchored.
An invented quote with a right line number: placed by the line, flagged.
A file-level finding (a missing test): no line, posted as a general comment; found by 2 runs.
A prose quote cited two lines off (11, an empty echo): placed on the nearby line that names `GBRANCH_BASES`.
Two lines of code quoted as one, cited off: found by the quote without whitespace, on its first line (44).
The file named without directory or extension, as a bare class name: the one file called gbranch.*, file-level.
No line and no quote, only a name: `candidates` is placed on the first changed line that names it (43).
